title: Some More of Our Treasure Items

items.name: 116.7 carat pear cut Tanzanite
items.description: First discovered 1967, became December birthstone in 2002
items.location: Found only in one very small region in the world (Tanzania)
items.rarity: Deposits estimated to be completely mined around 2043
items.value: Can be priced up to $3000 plus per carat
items.note: Shape and size would make particularly dazzling pendant

items.name: 351.65 gram gold nugget from Australia
items.description: Australian gold nuggets typically purest in world
items.note: One of author's favorite gold pieces in treasure

items.name: 9.65 carat diamond in octahedral form
items.description: Almost perfect octahedral form, unaltered natural state
items.rarity: Author not personally aware of any other similarly formed natural diamond of this size and quality

items.name: Two gold, emerald and ruby rings from 19th century South India
items.description: Arrangement of precious stones make them 'floral' rings, mimic flowers
